effects.noDeviceNotice: No device controlled: the library can be browsed and the preview runs on the default layout, but applying an effect needs a device Candeo is allowed to control.

costs.host: host loop · runs with the window closed
costs.hardware: firmware · no processor time · survives everything

effects.effectError: Effect error, on the current frame: {error}
effects.previewError: Error in the previewed effect, with no consequence for the keyboard: {error}
effects.missing: “{name}” is no longer in the folder.

preview.device: Frames from the engine, exactly the ones sent to the keyboard.
preview.hardware: Run by the firmware: the application does not receive its frames, there is nothing to animate here.
preview.noDevice: Preview on the default layout: nothing is sent anywhere, and no device is controlled.
preview.elsewhere: Preview: nothing is sent to the keyboard, where “{name}” keeps running.
preview.apply: Preview: nothing is sent to the keyboard. “Apply” sends this one there.
preview.stopped: The preview stopped on an error.
preview.defaultLayout: Drawn from the default layout: no device open.

effects.frozen: The preview is not running. The values below stay remembered, and “Apply” will start the effect with them.
effects.noParamsHardware: Run by the firmware: it exposes no setting to the application.
effects.noParams: This effect declares none: it does the same thing every time it starts.
effects.savedNoDevice: Values declared by the effect. They are only remembered for a controlled device.
effects.savedKept: Settings saved for {device}: they are used the next time this effect starts, including from the notification area.
effects.savedDeclared: Values declared by the effect. What differs from them is saved for {device}, without asking.
effects.footerHardware: run by the device · nothing to edit
effects.footerPreview: the preview runs as soon as an effect is selected · “Apply” sends to the keyboard
effects.deleteDetail: The effect's file is deleted: this is hand-written code, and nothing reinstalls it. The settings kept for it are forgotten, and its loop stops on the devices where it runs. Other effects are not touched.
effects.restoreOriginalDetail: Changes made to this file are lost: duplicate it first to keep them.

spectrumCycle.name: Spectrum Cycle
spectrumCycle.summary: The whole keyboard changes hue together, endlessly.

wave.name: Wave
wave.summary: A gradient crosses the keyboard from side to side.

effects.swatchKnown: Colors sampled by running the effect

editor.name: Effect name
editor.draftRestoredBuiltin: Draft restored — a built-in effect is not saved: duplicate it to keep it.
editor.draftRestored: Draft restored — this version was not saved.
editor.effectError: Effect error, on the current frame: {error}
editor.hint: The code is transpiled here and run by Rust: an effect sees neither the DOM nor the application. This engine has no console, and autocompletion does not offer one.
editor.noKeyboard: No keyboard connected: drawn from the default layout.
editor.nameRequired: Name the effect before saving it
editor.compileErrors: {n} error in the effect — line {line}: {message} | {n} errors in the effect — line {line}: {message}
editor.savedButBroken: The effect is saved, but it does not load

tray.stillRunningBody: Effects keep running. To quit, right-click the Candeo icon in the notification area, then “{quit}”.
tray.notOpenReason: Plugged in but not open — see the window

automations.title: Automations
automations.lead: A rule interrupts the effect applied on a device for a while, then gives it back.
automations.noDevice: No controlled device: control one in Devices, then choose it in a rule.
automations.name: Name (optional)
automations.missingEffect: The effect “{effect}” is no longer in the library: this rule does nothing.
automations.unreadable: This rule was changed outside Candeo into something it cannot show.
automations.empty: No rule yet. Start from the examples — they are added switched off, to adjust first.
automations.priority: When two rules apply at once, the higher one wins.
automations.idleField: When nobody uses the computer for
automations.idleRuleUnavailable: This system does not say when the computer is idle: this rule does nothing.
automations.expressionHelp:
Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week (0 is Sunday), or six with seconds first. * means any, */15 every 15, 1-5 a range, 1,3,5 a list.
Examples: 0 * * * * every hour · 30 12 * * 1-5 at 12:30 on weekdays · 0 9-18 * * * every hour from 9 to 18 · */30 * * * * * every 30 seconds.

devices.title: Devices

summary.controlled: no device controlled | 1 device controlled | {n} devices controlled

devices.matrix: matrix {rows} × {cols} · frame of {frameLen} colors · {keys} lit keys
devices.neverSeen: A device never seen before is listed but not controlled: the decision is made once, then remembered.

warnings.firmwareDiffers: Firmware {read}, while this layout was surveyed on {surveyed}. The protocol has probably not changed; but if the keyboard does not obey, this is the first lead.
warnings.firmwareNotRead: Firmware version not read ({reason}): it cannot be compared with the surveyed one ({surveyed}).
warnings.unsupported: This firmware does not know the “{name}” command ({command}): it is no longer sent.
warnings.readBackDiffers: The “{name}” command ({command}) is accepted, but the device reads back {read} after {wrote} was rewritten: it no longer understands it as when it was surveyed.

errors.startupHeldByUser: Launch at login was turned off in Task Manager. Turn it back on there, under Startup apps.
errors.startupHeldByPolicy: A policy on this computer keeps Candeo from starting at login.
errors.nameTooLong: An effect name is {max} characters at most.
errors.nameEdges: “{name}”: an effect name cannot start or end with a space or a dot.
errors.nameReserved: “{name}” is a name reserved by Windows.
errors.builtinNotSaved: “{name}” is a built-in effect: duplicate it to change it.
errors.builtinNotRenamed: “{name}” is a built-in effect: duplicate it to rename it.
errors.builtinNotDeleted: “{name}” is a built-in effect: it cannot be deleted from Candeo.
errors.builtinNameTaken: One of your effects is already named “{name}”: rename it to restore the built-in one.
errors.effectChanged: “{name}” changed while it was compiling: refresh the library.
errors.effectNotCompiled: “{name}” is not compiled yet: refresh the library.
errors.settingsUnreadable: The settings in {path} cannot be read: {detail}
errors.deviceNotFound: Keyboard not found: plug it in and try again.
errors.commandUnsupported: This firmware does not support command {command}.
errors.noFirmwareEffect: “{device}” runs no effect of its own: choose one from the library.
errors.wrongUnit: The plugged-in unit (serial {fingerprint}) is not the one that was controlled: it stays closed. “Control” adopts it too.
errors.deviceClosed: Device closed: reconnect it from Devices.

startup.title: Startup
startup.resumeDetail: When Candeo starts or a keyboard is plugged back in, the effect applied on it starts again.
startup.loginDetail: Candeo starts hidden in the notification area, with no window.

version.title: Candeo {version}
version.checkDetail: At startup, Candeo asks GitHub whether a newer version is published. Nothing is downloaded.
version.store: The Microsoft Store keeps Candeo up to date.
version.unreadable: The latest version, {version}, cannot be compared with this one.

log.title: Log
log.filesKeptDetail: One file a day; 0 keeps them all.
log.verbose: Detailed level on: the log grows fast and stays on after a restart.
log.forcedByEnv: CANDEO_LOG imposes the {level} level for this run. The setting above applies at the next launch without that variable.
log.noFolder: No file: the log could not open its folder.
log.copyRefused: The system refused to copy: the text is below, to select.

config.title: Configuration
config.confirmTitle: Start again from the default configuration?
config.detected: Every device goes back to detected: none is opened at startup any more.
config.stopped: Running effects stop and the backlight turns off, rather than staying frozen on the last frame.
config.forgetDevices: Each device's applied effect and brightness are forgotten: everything starts again at full brightness, with no effect.
config.forgetParams: The settings kept for each effect, on each device, are forgotten.
config.effectsKeptDetail: Deleting them is another action, one effect at a time, from the library.
